description: Renovate config for Ambient — automated dependency-update PRs across the Rust + JS + GitHub Actions stacks.

packageRules.description: Tauri family travels together — major/minor jumps in the plugin set need to land in lockstep with the core crate.
rav1e + ravif both feed the HDR encoder; keep them aligned.
GitHub Actions get their own PR cadence so workflow bumps don't get buried in a chunk of code-dep updates.
Patch + minor lockfile-only bumps auto-merge after CI passes — keeps the noise floor low. Major bumps still create PRs for review.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
